activities.description: Rachel Maddow introduces her interview with Jon Stewart, mentioning his critique of 24-hour cable news.

narrativeProgression.description: Rachel Maddow sets the stage for the interview, raising audience interest in Jon Stewart's perspective on cable news.

Rachel Maddow is shown in the studio against a backdrop of screens displaying 'THE INTERVIEW' and Jon Stewart's picture.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Tone becomes confrontational with questions about Iraq War narrative
Somber reflection during WWII Japanese internment discussion
Lighthearted tone resumes with joke about criticism

narrativeProgression.description: Debate whether Bush genuinely changed his position on Iraq or engaged in strategic narrative manipulation.
The discussion focuses on whether the left engages in similar simplification strategies.
The conversation returns to Bush's assertions about WMDs.
Discussion shifts to the morality of waterboarding.
The dialogue concludes with Jon Stewart encouraging self-reflection.

scenes.title: Debating the Iraq War and Media Narratives
